formulation: Object fit. Does the declared corpus substantively address the political economy as mediated by AI — the production, circulation, attribution, extraction and enclosure of meaning where composition layers stand between works and readers? Internal evidence: A bounded corpus with per-work role tags: direct, relational, antecedent/contextual, or outside scope. Comparative rule: Read corresponding material for each candidate; apply the same role rules. Work whose object is the political economy *of* AI — industry power, generative-AI labor, material infrastructure — is eligible and is read mode by mode; its object fit is coded relational, and the difference is recorded, never counted against either program. Algorithmic mediation (ranking, recommending, deciding among authored documents) is the precursor field and is coded antecedent/contextual.
